A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

1) we add a planning step in the translation process to control the global structure of the sentence; 2) the planning step is achieved by learning a discrete structural representation; 3) the structural representations are learned by an adversarial auto-encoder; 4) the structural representations can be either learned automatically by beam search or manually specified by the user; 5) the learned representations can be used to control the global structures of the translation.
